name: SAT Latest News
author: SAY ALWAYS TRURH

sections.description:
SAT Latest News is a WordPress plugin that retrieves and displays the latest news from the official SAY ALWAYS TRUTH RSS feeds. It supports both Bengali and English news and provides flexible display options for website owners.

The plugin includes a settings page where administrators can select the news language, set the number of items to display, and choose whether to show featured images, publication dates, and summaries. Feed results are cached to help reduce repeated requests to the RSS sources.

News can be added to a website using a shortcode, the classic WordPress widget, or the Gutenberg block editor. Theme developers can also display the news using the PHP integration method.

RSS feed sources:
* Bengali: https://www.sayalwaystruth.com/feed
* English: https://www.sayalwaystruth.com/en/feed

Shortcodes

Add this shortcode to any post, page, or shortcode-enabled area:
[sat_latest_news]

The shortcode automatically uses the language and display options selected in the plugin’s Display Settings. You do not need to edit the shortcode when switching between Bengali and English.

You can optionally override the global settings for an individual shortcode, for example:
[sat_latest_news language=”en” count=”5″]

Optional attributes: title, language, count, show_thumbnail, show_date, and show_description.

PHP Integration

Use this code in your theme template. It follows the plugin’s Display Settings automatically:

echo do_shortcode( ‘[sat_latest_news]’ );
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sat-latest-news folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate SAT Latest News from the Plugins page.
  3. Open the SAT Latest News menu in the WordPress dashboard to configure the display settings.
  4. Add the news feed to your website using the shortcode, widget, or Gutenberg block.
